column1: # Bijoy visual typing order (Phase 3 composer tests; not run in Phase 2, which has no
# composer). Classic Bijoy emits glyphs in typing order, so legacy SutonnyMJ text shows
# the order typists use. Evidence: the Bijoy->Unicode reordering logic in
# well-known SutonnyMJ sample "Avwg" = আমি (w = ি stored before g = ম).
#   - pre-base kar (ি ে ৈ) is typed BEFORE the consonant cluster it belongs to
#   - reph (Shift+A) is typed AFTER the cluster it sits on, and after a following
#     post-base kar if there is one

column3: reph after the following post-base kar
অ + া = আ: Bijoy turns অ (Shift+F) + া (F) into আ
